arrival_intent: See what the physical shape of Chassis made possible in the finished mark.
background: Enjoys visual craft and notices the affordances of letters before the designer's reputation.
desired_payoff: A concrete account of how weight, cuts and negative space became working design material.
drawn_in_by: Descriptions of form precise enough to picture and a visible consequence of choosing this face.
put_off_by: A claim that the font simply looked sturdy or felt right without showing what its shapes could do.

arrival_intent: Understand why this design won over the other plausible candidates.
background: Likes a making-of story most when it shows the rejected routes and the order of discovery.
desired_payoff: An honest comparison in which Chassis was already ahead before Hughes's name acquired meaning.
drawn_in_by: Specific alternatives, selection criteria and a decision that could conceivably have gone another way.
put_off_by: A retrospective destiny story that hides the other fonts or turns the famous name into the reason.

arrival_intent: Find out whether the fictional crew's work genuinely determines the wordmark.
background: Enjoys designs whose visual decisions grow out of the world they represent.
desired_payoff: The crew's roles make the word's size, hierarchy and internal staging feel earned.
drawn_in_by: Causal links between the Specialists' jobs and what happens inside the letters.
put_off_by: A fun caper described beside a logo rather than built into it.

arrival_intent: Follow how an old artistic influence changed a present-day design decision.
background: Has experienced a work of art staying useful long after the first encounter with it.
desired_payoff: A believable bridge from childhood comics to a new way of looking at Chassis.
drawn_in_by: Specific remembered images and the later moment when their design lesson became active.
put_off_by: Nostalgia that occupies the page but never affects the mark.

arrival_intent: See whether the wordmark's hierarchy communicates before its backstory is explained.
background: Notices what a viewer encounters first and what a composition asks them to read next.
desired_payoff: A convincing reason for THE USUAL to recede and SPECIALISTS to carry the visual weight.
drawn_in_by: The relation between phrase, scale and meaning made inspectable.
put_off_by: A clever rationale that only works after a paragraph of explanation.

arrival_intent: Watch type, illustration and action become one composition rather than separate layers.
background: Likes designs that use their materials as a stage instead of decorating an underlying label.
desired_payoff: A clear transition from selecting a font to making the caper happen inside the word.
drawn_in_by: Letters doing work: paths, obstacles, containment and movement within the forms.
put_off_by: Characters pasted around a static logo while the letterforms themselves remain inert.

arrival_intent: Borrow a way of thinking for a different creative problem.
background: Makes things and prefers a useful question over a recipe for reproducing someone else's result.
desired_payoff: A transferable move: ask what the story requires of the material, then look again at the chosen form.
drawn_in_by: The moment a weak selection question becomes a better making question.
put_off_by: A singular finished artefact with no inspectable move between brief and decision.

arrival_intent: See the actual sequence of making, including uncertainty and accidents.
background: Distrusts origin stories that make every discovery look planned from the start.
desired_payoff: A decision that remains good without pretending the author foresaw every connection.
drawn_in_by: Memory qualified at the right scale, revisions of thought and inconvenient details such as Korolev.
put_off_by: A polished account that erases coincidence or claims the designer's name made the choice inevitable.

arrival_intent: Enjoy the moment a practical design problem becomes a playful possibility.
background: Values inventive work that keeps the maker's delight without losing the brief.
desired_payoff: A surprising use of the letters that feels both funny and right for this crew.
drawn_in_by: Concrete imaginative play, especially when the caper turns the font's cuts into places and actions.
put_off_by: Solemn design justification or whimsy with no job to do.

arrival_intent: Judge what the finished mark gives someone who has not read the making-of story.
background: Appreciates the author's process but also imagines meeting the artefact cold.
desired_payoff: A wordmark whose scale and staging can carry some of the caper on their own.
drawn_in_by: Attention to the viewer's first encounter and a finished choice that survives outside the essay.
put_off_by: Meaning that lives entirely in the author's explanation rather than in the thing made.
